name: Get to Know Them
message: You want opportunities to get to know them better and hear about their story.

name: Spiritual Conversation
message: You want to have a meaningful spiritual conversation with your One, being able to hear their story and share your own.

name: Gospel Conversation
message: You want prayer for boldness to share the Gospel with your One.

name: Caring for your One
message: You want others to pray for the things going on in your One's life and wisdom for you to find ways to serve your One.

name: Invitation
message: You want to invite your One somewhere, maybe outside the context where you know them.

name: Confidence
message: You want prayer to grow in confidence in sharing your testimony.
